refs.normalized_quote: Synthetic maintenance note: Particulate accumulation can increase filter differential pressure. The resulting flow restriction reduces downstream pressure during high demand. Differential-pressure and downstream-pressure transmitters provide alarms and inspection triggers.

refs.normalized_quote: Synthetic GraphRAG relation path: filter restriction causes low burner-manifold fuel pressure; low fuel pressure can produce a lean fuel-air condition; the lean condition reduces combustion stability margin and increases flame fluctuation.
